name: techHUD
title: Tech HUD
description: Tactical telemetry interface, deep navy slate backdrop, laser cyan data lines, amber status warnings, monospace typography, and precision snaps.
do: Incorporate precise telemetry reticles, coordinates, and bounding brackets
Use monospace typography with generous technical letter tracking
Execute transitions with micro-second snap steps and telemetry blips
dont: Do not use casual hand-drawn, cursive, or romantic serif fonts
Avoid organic wobbly curves that feel loose or inaccurate
Never clutter the target focal point with unreadable telemetry noise
